headline: Request for qualifications (RFQ) for sale of SAU building at 18 South Main Street, and school district treasurer appointment.
summary: Deliberations cover a request for qualifications for the sale of the SAU building at 18 South Main Street and a school district treasurer appointment. Administration and committee reports are also on the agenda.
items: Public comment from residents, parents, and employees (3 minutes per person, 30-minute period)
RFQ for sale of SAU building (18 South Main Street), deliberation
Member updates and any other business
Future meetings: September 22, 2026 joint workshop and regular meeting; October 13, 2026 regular meeting
Nonpublic session (if needed, under RSA 91-A:3, II)
location: Derry Municipal Center, 3rd Floor Meeting Room, 14 Manning Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038
